not_granted: missing, stale, non-comparable or volume-mismatched price evidence

price_policy.register_blocked_means: missing or invalid price evidence only; never margin or breakeven

margin_advisory.note: Advisory only. Falling below any of these produces a profitability warning in the run result, registry and listing gate. It never skips, drafts or blocks.

shop_com_live_comparable.undercut: just below the lowest comparable shop.com price (.99 ending)

serpapi_google_shopping.price_factor_note: 95% of the per-product US median, same rule as pricing_model.offer_for
serpapi_google_shopping.price_claim_note: A reference price basis. It is NOT the exact market-lowest price; only a verified same-item comparator (shop_com_live_comparable) may support a competitive-minimum claim.

oliveyoung_us_benchmark.reason: Category-wide benchmark is neither product-level nor volume-comparable

manufacturer_safety_record.source_of_record: data/manual/mocra_business.json overlaid by private data/manual/mocra_profile.json (private wins, never exposed)

volume_comparison.compare: total volume (unit size x pack count) in the same base unit

image_policy.note: Only images listed here (exact canonical Daiso CDN path AND sha256 of the downloaded bytes, with reviewed_by and reviewed_at) may be uploaded. Listed paths are fetched even when pdImgUrlList does not advertise them (union of advertised and listed paths). reviewed_by must state truthfully who or what inspected the image; automated visual inspection must say so and is not human approval. The YuNet face detector stays on as an additional veto and ordering step; it is NOT a guarantee that an image is face-free. An empty allowlist means no product gets images and every candidate stays DRAFT.

pd_no.path: /canonical/daiso/cdn/path.jpg (starts with a single slash; no scheme, host, query, fragment or ..)
pd_no.sha256: 64 lowercase hex chars of the downloaded image bytes
pd_no.reviewed_by: truthful reviewer label, e.g. 'Aside automated visual inspection (not human approval)'
